messages:
Lina: Quick pulse — ACME onboarding health check. Noticed an uptick in overall error rate this week; main breakdown: 5xx spikes, streaming timeouts, and some rate-limit responses on embeddings. TL;DR: 5xx ~3.4% (concentrated on /v1/generate), timeouts ~1.8% (streaming), rate limits ~0.9% (embeddings). Spend up ~12% last week due to retries. Posting the top failing endpoints and suggested next steps below.

Alex: Got it — can you paste the raw top-endpoint counts + any sample logs? Customer has a renewal conversation next Wed, need a short summary for them.

Lina: Sure — raw snapshot from the dashboard for the last 7d:```/v1/generate         1,240 errs (3.4%)  -> 65% 5xx (502/503)
/v1/stream           680 errs (1.8%)   -> 70% timeouts (client stream closed / server deadline)
/v1/embeddings      210 errs (0.9%)    -> 55% rate_limit (429 bursts)
/internal/kv-sync    95 errs (0.26%)   -> 40% 5xx (timeout + OOM)
```Notes: median P95 latency for generate rose from 180ms -> 320ms on spike days. Streaming sessions time out around 25–30s (client sees disconnect). Embeddings bursts correlate with nightly batch jobs at 03:00 UTC.

Tom: From infra: we observed multiple pod restarts on the g4dn pool Tue 03:40 UTC — kernel OOMs while serving long sequences. Autoscaler also hit burst limit Mon night (requests queued). Two suggestions: pin ACME to a dedicated pool for onboarding burst windows, and increase streaming request timeout to 35s while we stabilize. Also adding retry-with-idempotency for generate calls will reduce duplicate work.

Maria: Heads-up: Acme's contract renewal is 04/02. They've flagged UX regressions to procurement. CS should send a proactive note tonight outlining mitigation and ETA. Also ask product to consider a temporary quota bump for embeddings during their migration window.

Lina: Proposed action items: 1) Tom — open infra ticket to investigate restarts and evaluate dedicated pool for ACME (INC-2367). 2) Engineering — add 35s stream timeout + lightweight retry wrapper with jitter for generate. 3) CS (Maria) — send a short customer note with incident summary + next steps; call out ETA for fix. 4) Ops — apply temporary 2x quota bump for embeddings for 72h. Anyone object?

ops-bot: Ticket created: INC-2367 - g4dn pod restarts during ACME onboarding. Link: https://tickets.redwood/INC-2367

Tom: On it. I'll add an alert for stream latency > 10s and put a dashboard tile on the ACME account view for top error classes. Will also check kernel logs and GC patterns.

Alex: Thanks team. Maria — I can draft a 3-line blurb for CS to send, and include the current mitigation steps and ETA.

Lina: Perfect — Maria, once you send, drop the customer thread here and we'll track. Will re-check next Thursday. :thumbsup:
